data.narrative: Constructed a comprehensive, production-grade GitHub Actions CI/CD automation pipeline with rigorous fail-fast testing and security controls. Configured deterministic npm dependency caching, enforced immutable git-SHA image tagging with 200MB size guardrails, isolated registry publish steps strictly to verified main branch pushes, and successfully diagnosed and mitigated secret exposure and cache poisoning vulnerabilities during the failure drill.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced container size guardrails directly inside the CI runner, verifying that the built Docker image does not exceed 200MB before tagging or registry upload.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added CI inspection script asserting image size in bytes against 209,715,200 byte limit.

dimension_scores.observation: Architected a sequential fail-fast pipeline with clear stage boundaries: lint -> build -> test -> docker build -> size guardrail -> container registry push.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured .github/workflows/ci.yml with actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 dependency caching, and fail-fast stage gating.

dimension_scores.observation: Configured clean confirmation logging of published container image tags (git SHA) while strictly suppressing authentication credentials from stdout/stderr.
dimension_scores.evidence: Printed explicit image URI confirmations while relying on automated masking (***) for GITHUB_TOKEN.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified the operational dangers of untested feature branch images contaminating the registry and unmasked secret echo statements leaking credentials in build logs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Enforced if conditionals restricting registry login and push strictly to verified commits on main.

dimension_scores.observation: Configured job-level execution limits (timeout-minutes: 15) to prevent hung integration test suites from consuming infinite runner credits.
dimension_scores.evidence: Specified timeout-minutes: 15 at the GitHub Actions job definition level.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored comprehensive verification checklists and root cause documentation analyzing cache invalidation, secret leaks, and pipeline latency business impacts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Recorded structured diagnostic logs in progress/module_02_break_diagnosis.json and verification proof in progress/module_02_build_proof.json.

strengths: Zero-trust credential discipline: never prints credentials to stdout and leverages encrypted repository secret vaults
Fail-fast pipeline hygiene: cheap static checks and unit tests run before resource-intensive Docker image builds
Immutable artifact governance: tags images with exact git commit SHAs rather than ambiguous latest tags
data.recommendation: Extend this automated discipline into Module 03 by formalizing Twelve-Factor environment configuration and runtime secret management.

public_evidence.student_action: Configured complete GitHub Actions CI/CD automation pipeline with lint, test, container build, size verification, and registry publishing.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Workflow file defining triggers, npm lockfile caching, fail-fast test gating, and branch-isolated ghcr.io publishing
public_evidence.proof: Verified workflow syntax and sequential gate execution stopping container builds on simulated test failures.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Eliminates 'works on my machine' human error, prevents broken builds from reaching container registries, and enforces repeatable automated verification.

public_evidence.student_action: Added standardized lint and typechecking commands to root and workspace manifests for pipeline integration.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Added 'npm run lint' executing tsc --noEmit across the TypeScript monorepo
public_evidence.proof: Verified npm run lint execution exit code 0.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Standardizes build and lint commands across local developer machines and remote CI virtual environments.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Separated continuous integration quality checks from continuous delivery image publishing with branch filters.
Eliminated echo debug statements and used GitHub Secrets with automated log masking.
Configured package-lock.json hash-based caching to prevent redundant package downloads.

teaching_approaches.detail: Examined intentional test breakage in failure drill to confirm downstream container build is skipped.
